commentDifference: // is for single-line comments; /* ... */ is for multi-line block comments.
nestedComments: Cannot be nested because the first closing delimiter */ immediately ends the block comment, causing a syntax error.
preprocessorRole: Comments are stripped and deleted by the preprocessor during the first phase and do not exist in the binary file.
docCommentExample:
/**
 * @brief Calculates the sum of two integers.
 * @param a First value.
 * @param b Second value.
 * @return Sum of a and b.
 */
